metadata.subject: English
metadata.countingRule: Main Topics and Skills are counted by grade placement. Repetition across different grades is preserved as intentional curriculum progression.
integrityRules: Repeated topics and skills across different grades are preserved.
Only exact Grade + Main Topic + Subtopic duplicates are removed.
Case-only Main Topic differences are normalized without changing meaning.
Age-only, adult, IELTS, and grade-not-stated records remain outside Grade 1–12 pages.
Rows without a Subtopic / Skill are preserved in a review file and are not rendered as empty content.
Empty grade sections remain in the JSON structure but are hidden from public pages.

description.en: Main ideas, details, inference, text structure, author perspective, theme, evidence, literary and informational text analysis, and comparison across texts.
description.ar: الأفكار الرئيسة والتفاصيل والاستنتاج وبنية النص ومنظور الكاتب والموضوع والأدلة وتحليل النصوص الأدبية والمعلوماتية والمقارنة بين النصوص.
